card.title: No Trouble at All
card.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course your brother can stay for dinner. I'll give him my pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please don't worry. There are peas, and I had a substantial breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. I'll keep everyone company while they eat, then you can all watch me have dinner at nine.

mechanism: A graciously gives up dinner and accepts delayed replacement while making hunger and waiting increasingly visible.
confusable: Unlike openly refusing inconvenience, A must continue accommodating while explicitly displaying its cost.
comparison: D45-a narrates a late solitary dinner; D45-b narrates distributing carrying strain across shoulders and fingers.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
